chars.S: SISTER: a young woman wearing an oversized mustard-yellow hoodie, grey jogger trousers and pink house slippers.
chars.N: BROTHER: a young man wearing a black t-shirt with white stripes on the sleeves, olive cargo trousers and white wireless earbuds.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the dark hallway of a modest Moroccan apartment in Meknes at night: the SISTER stands in the half-open doorway of her bedroom, head-to-waist, face clearly visible, glancing sideways nervously while she pushes the door shut with one hand, warm lamp light behind her. Suspicious, secretive mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: The BROTHER tiptoes along the same narrow hallway at night past a closed bedroom door with a thin line of warm light under it, looking back at it over his shoulder, curious face.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The BROTHER sits on his bed in his small bedroom at night, back against the wall, phone in his hands, white earbuds in, lit by the phone screen, a game controller on the blanket. Calm, trying to relax.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The BROTHER on his bed pulls one earbud out and leans toward the bedroom wall with a shocked, puzzled face, listening hard to sounds coming through the wall; a poster and a small lamp on the wall. Comic surprised expression.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the dark hallway the BROTHER, crouching a little, presses his ear against his sister's closed bedroom door, one hand slowly reaching for the door handle, warm light glowing under the door, wide nervous eyes. Cliffhanger tension, slightly comic.
